name: The majority voted in favour of [amendments](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2017-10-25.124.2) to the [bill](http://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/s1042). These amendments were introduced by Justice Minister [Michael Keenan](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/stirling/michael_keenan). ### What does this bill do? The bill creates mandatory minimum sentences and increases maximum penalties for the offences of trafficking firearms or parts of firearms both within Australia and between Australia and the rest of the world. Read the [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd1617a/17bd029) for more information.
